description: This source file defines an interface and multiple classes related to transaction overload detection within Orleans framework, including options configuration, load measurement, and overload status determination.

classes.name: TransactionRateLoadSheddingOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for controlling load shedding based on transaction rate, including enabling and limit settings.

classes.name: TransactionOverloadDetector
classes.description: Implements detection of transaction overload conditions by monitoring transaction throughput and applying load shedding logic.

methods.name: RecordStatistics
methods.description: Records current transaction statistics and updates internal metrics.

methods.name: IsOverloaded
methods.description: Determines whether the transaction system is currently overloaded based on monitored metrics and configuration settings.

methods.name: CalculateTps
methods.description: Calculates transactions per second over a specific interval.
